author: Marcus Pfister

notes: Rainbow Fish is the quintessential book about sharing and friendship. Key vocabulary centres on fish anatomy (scales), emotions (lonely, beautiful), social actions (share, give, friend) and the ocean setting. The hero image must show the distinctive multi-coloured shimmering fish — generic Boardmaker fish symbols will not be recognisable to students. Consider pairing 'shiny' with a glitter or sparkle icon if available. 'Lonely' may need a sad/alone composite image. The octopus and starfish appear in the story but are secondary enough to omit from the 11 fringe slots in favour of higher-utility words.
